preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 2^16.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= degree[i] <= n - 1 for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each degree must be between 0 and n-1.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= s[i] < 2**16 for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each XOR sum s must be between 0 and 2^16 - 1.

postconditions.description: The number of edges m is half the sum of all degrees.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= a < n and 0 <= b < n for a, b in edges)
postconditions.description: Each edge must connect valid vertices within the range.
The number of edges output must match the calculated number of edges.
